caseName: Federated Department Stores, Inc. v. Lawrence E. Gerosa
caseNameFull: Federated Department Stores, Inc. v. Gerosa, Comptroller of the City of New York
attorneys: Wilbur H. Friedman and George G. Gallantz for appellant., J. Lee Rankin for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
